user_query: My company is organizing a sports event and we need to provide live streaming options to the attendees. Can you suggest the live streaming options available for the ongoing events? It would be great to have the translations of the menu items as well.

TaskList.description: Research available live streaming platforms suitable for sports events.
Compare features of the identified live streaming options (e.g., cost, quality, user feedback).
Request for translations of the menu items used by each live streaming platform.
Compile a list of recommended live streaming options along with translated menu items for attendees.
